description: Fonti acqua potabile Acquedotto Storico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappe.comune.genova.it. Level representing the sources of drinking water along the route of the Historical Aqueduct. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water sources Historical Aqueduct" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include manufatto, fontana, Point Of Interest, acquedotto, acqua potabile, opendata. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
